N-Track-1.name: Forward-Verified Signed-Hadamard Centroid Transplant (head_edit)
N-Track-1.mechanism: Split periodic batches into disjoint Proposal half P and Confirmation half Q; measure exact top-3 Voronoi partition-swap dormancy (shielded by Huygens rare-mode cost), probe M orthogonal signed-Hadamard splits on high-SSE donors on P, and commit transplants iff held-back Q confirms strict forward SSE reduction.
N-Track-1.equation: p_{i,m} = <x_i - mu_s, h_m>; delta_m^+- = mean_{+- p > 0}(p); Delta SSE_P(m) = sum_{x in P} [min(d_rem^2(x), d_+^2(x), d_-^2(x)) - d_1^2(x)]; keep iff Delta SSE_P(m*) < 0 and Delta SSE_Q(m*) < 0
N-Track-1.complexity_overhead: < 3% wall-clock (runs every eff_transplant_every <= 8 steps via O(B*K*D) top-3 + 1D half-space Hadamard probes)
N-Track-1.predicted_win_regime: Multimodal & imbalanced GMMs (zipf_gmm, low_nk32_gmm, multiscale_rare_outliers) and random-init e-means where live twin centroids share dense modes (N_d >= 0.1 mean(N)) while merged donors straddle separated modes.
N-Track-1.predicted_fail_regime: Isotropic continuous clouds (isotropic_gaussian) where Voronoi hole creation roughly cancels donor split gain so Q-confirmation rejects non-dead swaps.
N-Track-1.falsification_criterion: Falsified if paired 15-seed test MSE fails to improve significantly (Wilcoxon p >= 0.05 or mean delta >= 0) on multimodal GMM benchmarks or degrades rare-mode preservation.

N-Track-2.name: In-Run Held-Out Parabolic Trajectory Merge (quad_merge)
N-Track-2.mechanism: Hold out a small disjoint internal subset X_hold strictly from x_train (zero val/test access), track split-consistent tail EMA anchors over the final 70% of updates, fit closed-form 3-point parabolic vertices per usage-quantile part on exact hard-Voronoi loss over X_hold + global QUAD_SHRINKS, and fold X_hold statistics into closing centroids.
N-Track-2.complexity_overhead: ~32 forward assignments on <= 4096 held-out train rows (~2-4 ms on GPU)
N-Track-2.predicted_win_regime: Low-n/k regimes (low_nk32_gmm, cifar10_r18_512, zipf_gmm) on out-of-sample test MSE, capturing true hard-Voronoi boundary shifts across trajectory states.
N-Track-2.predicted_fail_regime: Pure in-sample train MSE on high-n/k clouds (where exact sample mean closing_mean is already optimal on fixed training assignments).
N-Track-2.falsification_criterion: Falsified if paired 15-seed out-of-sample test MSE fails to beat closing_mean (Wilcoxon p >= 0.05 or mean delta >= 0) in low-n/k regimes (n/k < 100).

N-Track-3.name: ANVIL-II Dual-Rail Gram-Newton-Schulz Polar Centroid Update (anvil_polar)
N-Track-3.mechanism: Maintain ANVIL-II fast (0.85) and slow (0.98) momentum rails on the (k, d) EMA displacement matrix, apply 6-step quintic Gram-Newton-Schulz polar orthogonalization on min(k, d) + per-lane RMS normalization norm-matched to ||Delta C_ema||_F, and anneal smoothly to 0 so late updates preserve e-means Appendix G convex-hull optimality.
N-Track-3.equation: P = GramNS_6((1 - beta_t) Delta C + beta_t (w F + (1 - w) S)); c_j <- c_j + (1 - lambda(t)) Delta c_j^{ema} + lambda(t) U_j
N-Track-3.complexity_overhead: O(k * d * min(k, d)) per active step (< 0.1 ms/step for min(k, d) <= 512)
N-Track-3.predicted_win_regime: Early-epoch strongly anisotropic spectra (stretched_a2_t2) where polar singular-value equalization spreads centroids into secondary variance directions faster than raw EMA.
N-Track-3.predicted_fail_regime: Converged or heavy-tailed multimodal densities where isotropic singular-value whitening conflicts with Zador's p_j ~ rho(c)^{d/(d+2)} quantization density allocation.
N-Track-3.falsification_criterion: Falsified if paired 15-seed test MSE shows no statistically significant improvement (Wilcoxon p >= 0.05) on anisotropic/embedding benchmarks or degrades MSE.

N-Track-4.name: Zero-Overhead Split-Batch Antithetic Hadamard Voronoi Jitter (dust_antithetic)
N-Track-4.mechanism: Route half-batch B_+ against C + sigma(t)(r * E) and half-batch B_- against C - sigma(t)(r * E) at 1.00x FLOPs using unit-coordinate-RMS signed Hadamard frames E scaled by cluster RMS spread r_j, smoothing piecewise-constant Voronoi ridges with O(sigma^2) antithetic cancellation while keeping (N_j, S_j) strictly in the convex hull.
N-Track-4.equation: C^+- = C +- sigma(t) sqrt(E_j / (N_j d)) E_j; n_j = n_j(B_+, C^+) + n_j(B_-, C^-), s_j = s_j(B_+, C^+) + s_j(B_-, C^-)
N-Track-4.predicted_win_regime: Rugged real feature manifolds (cifar10_r18_512, cifar10_patches_128) and random-init e-means where shallow Voronoi ridge ripples trap deterministic hard routing.
N-Track-4.predicted_fail_regime: Cleanly separated warm-started clusters where Voronoi boundaries lie in low-density gaps so boundary jitter occasionally misroutes interior tail points.
N-Track-4.falsification_criterion: Falsified if paired 15-seed test MSE fails to improve significantly (Wilcoxon p >= 0.05) across real deep embedding and random-init benchmarks.

N-Track-5.name: Spatial-Quantile Stratified Batching & Late Wide-Step Schedule (speedrun_strat_wide)
N-Track-5.mechanism: Sort training vectors once in O(n*d) by 6-bit random-projection octant + radial surprisal into B strata so every mini-batch draws 1 sample per stratum (suppressing Binomial count variance), optionally doubling batch size to 2*B after wide_from=0.25 with coupled e-means step scaling alpha_0 * 2^0.9003.
N-Track-5.equation: strata = argsort(key).reshape(B_cur, S); batch_s = {strata[b, perm_b[s]]}_{b=1..B_cur}; B(p >= wide_from) = 2 B, alpha_0^{wide} = min(1, 2^{0.9003} alpha_0)
N-Track-5.complexity_overhead: < 0.2 ms one-time O(n*d) sort; wide-step reduces total step launches by ~37.5%
N-Track-5.predicted_win_regime: Imbalanced/multiscale distributions (zipf_gmm, multiscale_rare_outliers, cifar10) via variance-reduced batch counts, plus faster wall-clock time under wide-step doubling.
N-Track-5.predicted_fail_regime: Isotropic clouds where i.i.d. batches already have uniform cluster load, or random-init at T=2 if fewer total steps reduce dead-cluster revival opportunities.
N-Track-5.falsification_criterion: Falsified if stratified batching fails to improve paired MSE (Wilcoxon p >= 0.05) and wide-step fails to reduce wall-clock time at non-inferior MSE (<= +0.05%).
